subject: Conditional onboarding credit & badge packaging — exec signoff request
messages:
From: Helena Park <helena.park@healthify.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Healthify Procurement <procurement@healthify.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: tailored onboarding credit & badge package

Markus,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with latency and the routing options. Procurement asked me to capture our ask formally so we can move toward a procurement timeline:

- Pilot: 3 months, starting mid-April
- Request: 40% onboarding credit for first 90 days and inclusion of the "Enterprise Badge" (audit logs + extended retention) as part of the pilot package
- Expected ARR after pilot: $420k annualized if all goes well

We have a compact signing window (Procurement needs exec signoff by 3/10). Given this is outside standard rate card, can you escalate for VP/CFO signoff? I attached our draft SOW for reference.

Helena
Helena Park
Chief Procurement Officer, Healthify Inc.
helena.park@healthify.com

Attachments: Healthify_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 412KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Helena Park <helena.park@healthify.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: tailored onboarding credit & badge package

Helena — thanks for the note and the SOW. Short answer: we can consider an exception, but it'll need limited, documented guardrails.

Quick read of the ask and our internal constraints:
- 40% onboarding credit is materially above standard promotional thresholds for pilot-sized ARR.
- "Enterprise Badge" (audit + extended retention) is normally a paid add-on; including it increases platform exposure and operating cost.

Proposed commercial counter (pending exec signoff):
- Pilot term: 3 months as requested
- One-time onboarding credit: 25% of the pilot invoice (applied to first invoice)
- Include Enterprise Badge for the pilot at no additional charge, conditional on a 12-month auto-renew at a minimum committed ARR of $350k (or equivalent usage floor)
- Add a clause that future retention increases will be billable after pilot

I am escalating to Kimberly for VP/CFO signoff and legal to add the commitment/usage-floor language. Attaching a short deal summary for internal review.

Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: deal_summary.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Helena Park <helena.park@healthify.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: tailored onboarding credit & badge package

Markus / Helena — I reviewed the ask and Markus' proposed counter. I will approve a limited exception with the following conditions:

1) Onboarding credit capped at 25% for the pilot invoice only.
2) Enterprise Badge included for the 3-month pilot at no charge, contingent on a signed 12-month contract that contains a minimum committed ARR of $350k or an agreed usage floor that protects Redwood economics. (Legal to add a clear clawback if renewal doesn't occur.)
3) One-time professional services credit of $15,000 applied to the pilot to help accelerate integration (to be invoiced and then credited).
4) All agreed terms must be executed via DocuSign and include the renewal/usage-floor language.

Rationale: Healthify is strategically aligned and the probability of conversion is high, but we need to protect unit economics and set the right renewal guardrails. This approval is restricted to the terms above and is not precedent for broader commitments.

Naomi — please queue Legal to create the renewal clause and review the clawback language; include the usage floor template we used for other pilot exceptions.

Kimberly Park
VP, Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Subject: Re: Request: tailored onboarding credit & badge package — approved (conditional)

Helena — confirmed: Kimberly has approved a conditional exception (details below). We appreciate the quick turnaround. Next steps:

- I will send an exec approval memo to Legal for insertion into the final SOW and request DocuSign routing to your procurement contact.
- Please confirm you can commit to the 12-month contract with a $350k minimum ARR (or provide suggested alternative usage floor by EOD 3/3).
- Once Legal updates the SOW we will route for signature; DocuSign link will follow.

Approved exception (summary):
• 25% one-time onboarding credit applied to first invoice
• Enterprise Badge included during 3-month pilot at no charge (clawback if no renewal)
• $15,000 one-time professional services credit applied during pilot
• Renewal/usage-floor clause to be added to the SOW; execution via DocuSign required

Attachments: exec_approval_memo.pdf (PDF, 58KB)

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/xyz12345

Markus
Markus Klein
